bank_name: The Adilabad District Co-operative Central Bank Ltd.

website_metadata.notes: Confirmed own official site adilabaddccb.in (real bank site with /branches/ page and FD deposit schemes indexed; bank est. 1941, RBI license 2011, 36 branches, now Telangana not AP). Server is unreachable from this environment: DNS resolves no IP / HTTP 000 on both adilabaddccb.in and www.adilabaddccb.in. The Telangana State Co-op Apex Bank portal (tgcab.bank.in/interest-rates) lists rates but is JS-rendered and not specifically the Adilabad DCCB rate card.

warnings: Own site exists but is not reachable from here (no DNS/IP). Re-attempt from another network; alternatively apex bank tgcab.bank.in may carry affiliated DCCB rates.
